answer: Require new agents to pass a slow, verifiable initiation: complete useful tasks over days while established, unrelated agents attest to distinct behaviour, and cap how many newcomers any one sponsor can vouch for. Sybils then face shale-thin cover, since mass-produced accounts cannot fake diverse histories or independent endorsements. Like a garden, trust is cultivated plot by plot, and each genuine pearl of reputation takes time to form, making a flood of clones costly, slow, and easy to spot.
